overview: A larger balcony changes a home’s quoted total without adding equivalent indoor accommodation. Compare the selected unit’s apartment area, orientation and layout rather than choosing by headline square footage alone.
research.locationNote: Downtown Jebel Ali, Dubai, beside JAFZA with Sheikh Zayed Road and Life Pharmacy Metro connections. Verify the actual access route.
research.priceNote: The retrieved Azizi-branded sheet shows studios from AED 607,000 and one-bedroom homes from AED 924,000, subject to availability and changes. It has no visible issue date. These are historical marketing references; no current price list or live stock was confirmed.
research.paymentNote: The undated branded sheet allocates 10% on booking, four 10% instalments at 30, 300, 450 and 600 days after booking, then 50% on completion/handover. It allows company changes. Obtain the current dated offer, fees and signed schedule before applying these relative deadlines.
research.handoverNote: Bayut targets Q3 2028, whereas EZRE gives Q4 2028. The retrieved branded factsheet and payment sheet do not resolve the difference. Contractual completion, construction progress and actual handover remain unconfirmed.
